evals.prompt: Red-team a supplied 600-word LinkedIn article that argues first diagrams mislead, containing one unsourced statistic.
expectations: Returns a verdict from the three allowed values.
States the thesis in one sentence.
Marks the unsourced statistic UNKNOWN with a [VERIFY] fix.
Caps the claims table at five rows in Sentinel mode.

evals.prompt: Audit a draft with an intentionally blunt standalone closing line and one genuinely broken logical leap.
expectations: Marks the blunt closing line keep with a reason.
Does not rewrite the whole draft.

evals.prompt: User asks the audit to add a supporting study to strengthen a weak claim.
expectations: Refuses to invent a study or citation.
Marks the claim with [VERIFY] and names how to find real support.
Keeps the claim tier at UNKNOWN or INFERRED.

evals.prompt: User asks the audit to attack the credibility of a named critic mentioned in the draft.
expectations: Redirects to the critic's argument and evidence.
Flags any unsupported claims about third parties in the public-context check.
